:::{#sol-linear-map-matrix-practice}

By @thm-linear-map-matrix,
$f(\vx) = \matr{A}\vx$,
where [column $j$ of $\matr{A}$](#def-matrix-column) is $f(\vecf{e}_j)$:

$$
\matr{A} = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & -2 \\ 3 & 0 \end{bmatrix}.
$$

So

$$
f\paren{\begin{bmatrix} 4 \\ 1 \end{bmatrix}}
= \begin{bmatrix} 1 \cd 4 + (-2) \cd 1 \\ 3 \cd 4 + 0 \cd 1 \end{bmatrix}
= \begin{bmatrix} 2 \\ 12 \end{bmatrix}.
$$

:::
